messages:
maria: CI red on nightly shard 12 — a bunch of hosted API integration tests failing only in the pipeline. looks like a header/handshake mismatch?

devon: saw that. repro locally with the shard runner? or only on CI VMs? :thinking_face: 

maria: only on CI so far. logs show 401 for streaming endpoints and a weird 'unexpected-content-type' from the proxy. pasted snippet below.

maria: ```
2026-03-17T22:11:02Z STREAM_INIT failed status=401 header: x-auth-method=KID rotated
2026-03-17T22:11:02Z PROXY_ERR unexpected-content-type: multipart/form-data
```

devon: hmm, multipart/form-data for a streaming websocket handshake? that's odd. did any recent PR touch the test runner or the proxy header normalization?

sam: @devon @maria I merged #3245 yesterday (small proxy fix) that normalized Content-Type casing. could that have regressed something? cc: @claire who owns the proxy changes.

claire: looking. dashboard shows a small spike in 5xx/401 on the hosted ingress between 21:55–22:15 UTC. pushing a quick rollback to the canary now. :wrench:

ci-bot: nightly-shard-12 build 9842 failed (tests: 14/42 passed). rerun queued: https://ci.internal/runs/9842

maria: thanks. if rollback doesn't clear it, can we request a parallel rerun of shards 12/13 to bisect whether it's infra or code? i can prepare a minimal repro script.

devon: +1 for parallel reruns. also if you can attach the repro curl that hits the same path, helps me repro on a dev VM.

maria: repro curl:

maria: ```bash
curl -i -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -X POST https://hosted.redwood.example/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

maria: on CI it returns 401 + header x-auth-method: KID rotated; locally it works fine.

claire: rollback applied to canary 22:36 UTC. monitoring. if the canary looks stable i'll promote.

sam: can we also capture the raw request headers from the failing CI run? maybe the test harness is sending an extra boundary header.

maria: grabbed headers from the archived job:

maria: ```
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundaryr2
User-Agent: node-test-runner/1.2.3
Authorization: Bearer ***
X-Client: shard-12-runner
```

devon: there we go — the test harness is accidentally setting multipart content-type for streaming tests. looks like a recent change in the harness dependency bumped a library. i'll open a PR to pin it back and add a guard.

maria: awesome. parallel rerun queued while we wait for canary to stabilize. grateful for the quick rollback. :+1:

claire: canary looks clean now (22:44). promoting to prod in 10m unless we see regressions.

ci-bot: rerun started for shards [12,13] (run 9842-rerun-1).

sam: follow-up action items:
- devon to PR pin + harness fix
- qa to add a test ensuring streaming endpoints never set multipart content-type
- ops to verify no other batches used the new lib

maria: i'll add a brief postmortem note in #incidents after the rerun finishes. thanks all.
